text: B1d-06 opened: stretch 6 of the second pass, orders 574 (theblackvoid) to 627 (starcitizen), 11 chosen rooms not yet reread, 927,118 bytes of codes and second-order themes and 780,211 of forest (out/_analysis/b1d_stretch_sizes.py). Through prequelmemes (641) the stretch would be 1,107,253 bytes; stopping at starcitizen leaves a last stretch of 918,889 bytes, prequelmemes (641) to TheFarLeftSide (703), 12 rooms. Rooms in order: theblackvoid, detroitredwings, loltyler1, CKCrusaders, math, parahumans, PlaceNL, vinesauce, earthbound, homestuck, starcitizen. Group 1 (a gate failed at B1c): math, PlaceNL, vinesauce. Group 2 (most hesitations): theblackvoid, detroitredwings, loltyler1, CKCrusaders, parahumans, earthbound, homestuck, starcitizen (PlaceNL is in both lists). No contrary room in this stretch. Startup packet read: head, stage file, last five diary entries, scheme --brief (197 themes, 13,457 placements), validate.py --open B1 (0 errors, 0 warnings). saturation.py pass2: 85 of 108 chosen rooms read; run 85 rooms and 106.8 average rooms; next theblackvoid.

B1d room theblackvoid (order 574, group 2: the B1b room note left kinds for B1d in t01, t02, t04, t05, t06, t07, t09, t10, t11, t12 and t14) reread: A1 note, 15 second-order themes with every concept's words (1,915 concepts), and the forest whole (1,750 threads, 6,218 lines, printed in two runs, lines 1 to 5,002 and then from --offset 5002). One change, a bag (out/_analysis/b1d06_bags_theblackvoid.txt, checked with b1_precheck_bagfile.py and b1_check_bags.py; two tier lines written, tier_history 99; multiplacement 6,650): t07 (spreading tendrils and moving or multiplying cores) held T3-171 with T3-041 and T3-022; the reread found the argument over purity or expansion carried by about a dozen concepts of its own (c0209, c0294, c0673, c0797, c1037, c1040, c1101, c1255, with c0093, c0734 and c0747 on the other side), choosing upkeep over expansion (T3-042), as t06 holds that doing beside defending the core. It is now one placement in T3-171 with T3-041, T3-022 and T3-042 in the bag line; T3-041 and T3-022 were unplaced. Kinds missing from existing bags, recorded here: t02 (T3-149 with T3-150, T3-139, T3-084) lacks T3-193 arguing whether cooperation is surrender (c0055, and c0692, a carrying code of the A1 note, the Void refusing to negotiate) and T3-195 (c1373, c1467, c1580, Rainbow Road to be eliminated for breaking the treaty, allies made to prove commitment); t04 (T3-126 with T3-049, T3-114, T3-116, T3-132) lacks T3-118 (c0573, c1691, leaders and moderators blamed for the collapse), T3-115 (c1284, c1542, refusing to be a requester's army), T3-091 (c0569, c0631, c0655, moderators asked to pin one plan) and T3-090 (c0814, c1080, c1405, an alternative sub offering leadership); t05 (T3-069 with six kinds) lacks T3-006 (target proposals) and T3-149 (c0274, c0322, c0329, c0351, temporary peace with Germany and the hearts). Named here, beside themes that already hold three kinds: t01 T3-090 (c0512, c0871, c0890, c1448, r/PerfectEntropy as a hive-mind sub; the subs opened for the Void's work, r/00void, r/thevoidoffensive and r/ThePixelCycle among them, are spread over six themes and central to none); t06 T3-037 (c0723, c1399, c1583, c1909, the Void defended as art or a necessary evil); t09 T3-084 (c1156, c1197, c1595, c1772, outside rooms asking the Void to attack for them) and T3-139 (c0971, c1049, c1090, c1710, pleas to spare India, Tiny Rick, the furries and Waldo); t10 T3-050 (about eight outsiders' taunts, c0249, c0638, c1305, c1674, c1718, c1831), T3-105 (c0553, c0843, c1400) and T3-070 (c0298, c0634, c0653, maps of the Void); t11 T3-016 (c0474, c0494, c1625, newcomers asking what this is) and T3-163 (c1307, c1315); t12 T3-050 and title-only commands to place, defend and attack; t14 T3-014 (c1846) and T3-044 (c1907), single concepts. Carrying codes: c0058 (the Monochrome alliance) is carried by T3-150 in t02's bag; c0984 (the leaders said to have abandoned the room) by T3-126, kept in t04; c0692 by T3-193, missing from t02's bag. For the T3-188 gate at B1e: c0577 (t12), a member answering a critic that the original voiders left once a new wave joined and brigaded at random, setting the room apart from placers acting in its name, one concept; c0830, a member separating the person who places from the Void itself. National and political content read plainly: attack calls on flags and nations, Germany (split while it fights the French), the EU flag, Switzerland, Sweden (an ethnic slur, c0154; its flag called oppressive and a cheat for a stickied script, c1443, c1483), Ireland, Belgium, Finland, Norway, Denmark, Japan, Russia (an imperial-conquest call, c0757), India and Pakistan (requests both ways), Indonesia, Mexico, the UK and Wales, the Netherlands (retaliation, and a Dutch nationalist cheer for the Orange incursion, c1343, c1514), Australia and New Zealand (a warning off their pride flag, c1209), and the US flag, attacked at h65 to h67 against r/murica and r/straya and recounted as feeding on Americans' tears (c1465) and answered that America won (c1826); the hammer and sickle and communism (c0530, c0538, c0874, c1048, c1541, c1760) and the Kekistan flag (c1589), in t09's T3-080; an operation named after the potato famine (c1191); the trans flag and pride posters attacked with slurs (c0106, c0234, c0275, c0550, c0584, c0644, c0977, c1217), placed in t09's T3-006 with T3-080; riffs on Black Lives Matter and Make America Great Again (c0542, c1394, c0458, c0995), a racial taunt (c0077) and a riff on being judged by content of character (c1800); r/The_Donald proposed as recruits (c1115); OSU likened to Iraq after 2003 (c1005); 4chan's support and a strawpoll on contacting 4chan trolls (c0172, c0198, c0599). Named plainly; nothing left out or softened. The A1 note's not-this holds: Discord leaders, moderators and members gave rival orders and split into unofficial Discords (c0570, c0695, c1102, c1106, c1792). Episodes E993 to E1023 and the 20 joined lines stand. No new kind; the run is not reset.
